title: Common providers: Canada
coverage: Complete for the national carriers, the mobile network operators, the main cable operators and the national research network; regional independents and business ISPs are partial.
missing: Regional telephone companies, co-operatives and municipal networks
Websites for Telus, Cogeco, Eastlink, TekSavvy, Distributel, Northwestel and CANARIE (they did not answer an automated request on the read date)
The regulator's list of registered providers (the site refused an automated request on the read date)

sources.name: CRTC (Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission)
sources.terms: The site refused an automated request on the read date: its terms were not read and nothing is copied.
sources.result: Not read. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Canada and 5 more pages
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and former names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 13 of 16 entries were found by a name on the 6 pages read.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 9 of 16 websites and 1 support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider or a company the entry names.
sources.result: 22 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE NCC list of AS names
sources.terms: No licence statement was read: used only to find candidate AS numbers, each then confirmed as above; nothing is copied.
sources.result: Read to find which AS numbers are registered under each provider's company names.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 7 entries carry the id of a Wikidata item that states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797).

providers.name: Bell
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile. Networks named Aliant and MTS are registered to Bell Canada.

providers.name: Rogers
providers.notes: Cable and mobile. AS6327 is the Shaw cable network in western Canada, registered to Shaw Communications.

providers.name: Videotron
providers.notes: Cable and mobile. AS22652 is the Fibrenoire business network, registered to Videotron.

providers.name: Freedom Mobile
providers.notes: Both AS numbers are registered to Videotron.

providers.name: Xplore
providers.notes: Rural fixed wireless, fibre and satellite; formerly Xplornet.

providers.name: Zayo
providers.notes: AS15290 is registered as its Canadian network; Allstream has been owned by Zayo since 2016. AS6461 is the backbone the international pack lists.

providers.name: Northwestel
providers.notes: Carrier in Yukon, the Northwest Territories and Nunavut.
